visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up of steamed glutinous rice shrimp balls in a bamboo steamer; a hand uses wooden chopsticks to lift one, revealing a translucent texture, then cuts it open with scissors to show the pink shrimp filling. (2) Hands wearing plastic gloves place mounds of greyish shrimp paste into a glass bowl on a wooden surface, followed by peeled raw shrimp, minced ginger, and chopped green onions. (3) A male chef in a professional white uniform stands in a kitchen studio with a grey brick-patterned background, holding the glass bowl and mixing the ingredients manually with his gloved hands. (4) The chef adds egg white, cornstarch, white pepper, salt, and sesame oil to the mixture, followed by chopped orange carrots and yellow corn kernels, stirring until the paste is vibrant. (5) The chef holds a white plate covered in long-grain white glutinous rice, explaining the preparation; he then scoops the shrimp mixture into small rounds and rolls them in the raw rice until fully coated. (6) The coated balls are placed into a bamboo steamer lined with parchment paper; the lid is placed on top, and later removed to reveal the cooked balls garnished with goji berries and cilantro.
